thread:
Lina (AM): URGENT: Orion Health demo blocked. Streaming API yields truncated event payloads in their internal browser app behind Blue Coat proxy. Demo tomorrow.

Devon (SE): Are they using EventSource, fetch+ReadableStream, or our node SDK? Any example of the broken payload?

Lina (AM): They said EventSource-like client (custom wrapper). Paste from their network inspector: `data: {\"doc\":{\"text\":\"Patient report part 1 of 2...` then stream closes. JSON.parse fails on concat because second chunk never arrives. Req: r_req_8771.

Priya (Infra): Common culprit: corporate proxy doing HTTP/1.1 chunk consolidation or buffering when response has `Content-Encoding: gzip`. Gzip + proxy = buffer until finish. Ask them to disable compression for stream endpoints.

Marco (SRE): Also check whether HTTP/2 connection coalescing is in play. Some Blue Coat appliances terminate HTTP/2 and buffer for HTTP/1 backend, consolidating chunks. Workarounds: 1) disable gzip, 2) ensure `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` is forwarded, 3) send periodic SSE comment lines like `: \\n` every 7s.

Devon (SE): Quick test they can run to see chunking behavior: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?stream=true&model=mini\" | hexdump -C` to see incremental writes. If hexdump shows the second chunk missing, proxy consolidated.

Ben (Solutions): For the demo we can switch them to non-streaming `/v1/complete` as fallback but they'd like progressive updates. Is there a low-risk server-side toggle we can flip?

Marco (SRE): I can enable `sse_keepalive=comments` for their customer_id (orion-123) which will emit `:keepalive\n\n` every 6s and an extra `X-RW-Seq` header per SSE event. Low impact. Will run canary first.

Priya (Infra): I'll prepare an ops note for their infra team: include `proxy.buffering off` for nginx, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, disable response compression for that route, and increase idle timeout on Blue Coat/F5 to > 60s.

Lina (AM): Customer ops: can you try disabling gzip on the proxy and re-test? They'll also accept a server toggle if we can do it today.

Customer Ops (via DM): Trying disable gzip now, will report back in 20m.

Devon (SE): I found our server logs for r_req_8771: 
```
[2024-09-17T14:02:11Z] stream.write(req=r_req_8771, chunk_id=1) -> 124b
[2024-09-17T14:02:13Z] stream.write(req=r_req_8771, chunk_id=2) -> 98b
[2024-09-17T14:02:13Z] stream.end(req=r_req_8771) // connection closed by upstream
```
Their client shows chunk_id=2 missing. Upstream closed after second write. Need full raw bytes.

Priya (Infra): If upstream closed early, could be a networking middlebox dropping connection on perceived idle. We should check our gateway logs around `tcp_idle_close` and `http_proxy_flush`.

Ben (Solutions): Pricing question from Lina: if they move to Dedicated to avoid their corporate LB, what's the minimum commitment? (they asked)

Lina (AM): They want ballpark now.

Ben (Solutions): For demo purposes, tell them Dedicated monthly minimum is $Xk/mo for a single reserved pool; mention that Dedicated eliminates our shared ingress path and often avoids corporate proxy fiddliness since we can peer. But recommend trying proxy fixes first.

deploy-bot: Canary toggle `sse_keepalive=comments` enabled for canary-ring at 1729410200 by Marco.

Marco (SRE): Canary looks green. I'm enabling customer-specific tag `orion-123` now. Will post when live.

deploy-bot: Toggle live: `sse_keepalive=comments` applied for customer=orion-123 at 1729410450.

Lina (AM): Customer reports after we flipped toggle they received incremental events and no JSON truncation in 3 runs. They still want the proxy doc to avoid future surprises.

Priya (Infra): Copy of suggested proxy config for nginx: 
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";
  proxy_set_header Accept-Encoding ""; # disable gzip on proxy
  proxy_send_timeout 120s;
}
```
Blue Coat/F5 note: increase TCP idle to 90s, disable HTTP/2 reassembly if possible.

Devon (SE): Follow-up: recommend they add a simple client-side reconnect that buffers partial last message and attempts to re-fetch missing part via non-stream endpoint when JSON.parse fails. That reduces demo break risk.

Lina (AM): Customer will apply nginx snippet and test again. They also asked for an email summary and the Dedicated pricing skus. Ben can you send both?

Ben (Solutions): Will draft email: summary of cause (proxy chunking/gzip), steps taken (server keepalive toggle), nginx/F5 fixes, client fallback, and Dedicated SKU note. Sending in 30m.

Lina (AM): Update 17:06 — Customer applied `Accept-Encoding: ""` on their proxy and confirmed stable streaming for several 2-3 minute responses. Demo confirmed for tomorrow. Thanks team :party_popper:
